fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The Ouroboros as the Episode's Master Sigil", "body": "Chance opens on the title of Loki season two episode one, Ouroboros, treating the snake that eats its own tail as a compressed sigil. He points to older engravings carrying the Alpha and Omega inscription, reads the name through green language as O bore us, and offers the Greek gematria value 1082, which he links to the Hebrew phrase for Ursa Minor, the son of Aish, and to the Greek Kynosoura, the dog's tail. From there he ties it to the Fool's little dog circling the pole star, to the transmigration of souls, and to Oro and borro, gold and eating, as a figure for eternal return."}, {"title": "Loki as the Fool, Descending the Tree of Life", "body": "The central reading Chance offers is that this episode belongs to card zero. Loki jumps off a cliff within minutes, which he calls as overt as it gets, and the wind in his hair connects to the Latin follis, the windbag, and to the coin bag on the Thoth card. He places Loki on the eleventh path, from Kether down to Chokmah, ruled by Uranus, so the season is a journey into wisdom by seeing the whole circuit at once. Gabe adds that Loki and Sylvie swapped costumes between seasons into cards that carry ouroboros crowns and lemniscates in the older decks."}, {"title": "Aleph, Time Slips and the 111 Weave", "body": "Chance spells aleph out as aleph lamed peh to reach 101, then builds a list of 111 correspondences: Elohim hu ha Elohim, the philosopher's stone, argentum vivum as Argent Vif in Latin gematria, oikia for house in Greek, and Cephas, the Aramaic rock behind the TVA's stone statue. The same three letters repointed mean to teach or to slip, which he matches to Loki time slipping and to Casey listening to instructional tape. Rearranged as APL the letters read apple, misfortune and darkness, which he ties to Job chapter 28 and its line that the fear of the Lord is wisdom."}, {"title": "Gabe's Star Lore, Race Weave and Regime Changes", "body": "Gabe carries a parallel track through the episode. He reads the opening chase as a race pun, noting that conspiracy theorist contains race three times, and connects the Messier marathon, the single spring night when amateurs can catch every Messier object, to the Crab Nebula event recorded in 1054, the year the Catholic and Orthodox churches split. Later he argues that regime changes historically rewrite the courier system, from the Pony Express to the UPS and Amazon coverage he says the show echoed in an earlier Spider-Man decode, which lands on Loki arriving in a flying mail truck full of letters."}, {"title": "Black Holes, Repackaged Science and Sylvie's Salve", "body": "In the closing stretch Chance calls the 2019 radio image of the black hole at Messier 87 a picture of a hole in Virgo, notes the Event Horizon language arriving just before 2020, and argues that accepted cosmology descends from mysticism, citing the clergyman John Michell proposing dark stars in 1784 and the Big Bang as the Egg of Brahma. Gabe corresponds Stephen Hawking to the Chariot card and calls the charitable cause figure an Auriga spell. He closes on Sylvie, tracing her name to salve, the first word spoken by Athanasius Kircher's automaton, and to Talos, melted down into the first coins."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: In this episode we embark on the latter half of Marvel's Loki series, beginning with Season 2, Episode 1: Ouroboros. Tune in to learn about the esoteric encoding of the Tarot's Fool card, the divine spirit & breath of God, the ancient motif of the crucified savior, the fiction of Black Holes and spaghettification, the mystery of the letter A (Aleph, Alpha, etc.), and a whole lot more. This content will be fascinating and educational even for those who never watched the TV series that we're decoding, so don't miss out!
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "You do not need to have seen the Loki television series to appreciate the information we're going to be putting forward.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I'm always coming back to the Tarot deck, and I am quite convinced that this is the Tarot deck to the Death Star.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "I think a secret of alchemy and immortality is that you already have it, and the real mystery is how to keep your memory rather than how to continue existing.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I'm here to tell you that Hollywood doesn't care what the real community has to say.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "The fall of the fool is into time. The hanged man is matter crucified by time.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There is a huge pattern of when a regime change comes along, they always change the mailing system.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Everything that is accepted as scientific dogma is the mystery school tradition put into the packaging of materialism.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "That our misfortunes inevitably bring us closer to God is obvious for anyone who's had a long enough human life without losing their empathy or spirit or honesty.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
